name: J&B International Inc.
summary: J&B International Inc. is a company dedicated to manufacturing and supplying high-performance fabrics to markets both within Taiwan and across the globe. Their diverse array of textile offerings includes materials specifically engineered for athletic wear, yoga apparel, outdoor gear, snowboarding, surfing, athleisure, professional workwear, and personal protective equipment (PPE). Established in 1999, the firm's primary operations are based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
